pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark-brown regions with soft-to-moderate pixel gradients at the edges. Morphology transitions from large sub-polygonal patches on the mid-flank to smaller, more fragmented and elongated shapes on the shoulder and lower neck area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-cream topological network with variable pixel width. Junction nodes demonstrate a high density of tri-radiate intersections. Pathways are continuous across the visible torso, though narrowest between the largest flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, serrated 1D profile is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, exhibiting low-amplitude vertical protrusions representing a mane.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian hitchhikers (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal neck ridge and the posterior flank.
